module_description: A message containing per doc signals that are compressed and included in Mustang and TeraGoogle.

fields.name: siteAuthority
fields.description: site_authority: converted from quality_nsr.SiteAuthority, applied in Qstar.

fields.name: babyPandaDemotion
fields.description: baby_panda_demotion: converted from QualityBoost.rendered.boost.

fields.name: babyPandaV2Demotion
fields.description: New BabyPanda demotion, applied on top of Panda. This is meant to replace baby_panda_demotion.

fields.name: pandaDemotion
fields.description: Encoding of Panda fields in proto SiteQualityFeatures in quality/q2/proto/site_quality_features proto. The encoding/decoding is performed using functions from quality_coati::coati_util.

fields.name: exactMatchDomainDemotion
fields.description: exact_match_domain_demotion: converted from QualityBoost.emd.boost. Float values in [0,1] converted to integers in range [0,1023] (10 bits).

fields.name: authorityPromotion
fields.description: authority promotion: converted from QualityBoost.authority.boost

fields.name: unauthoritativeScore
fields.description: Unauthoritative score. Used as one of the web page quality qstar signals.

fields.name: scamness
fields.description: Scam model score. Used as one of the web page quality qstar signals. Value range from 0 to 1023.

fields.name: crapsAbsoluteHostSignals
fields.description: Impressions, unsquashed, host level, not to be used with compressed ratios. Not to be used in Pattern Data.

fields.name: crapsNewPatternSignals
fields.description: For craps [url|pattern]_signals, please avoid accessing these fields directly... use methods from quality/navboost/craps/craps-lossy-compression.h or talk to craps-team@.

fields.name: crapsNewUrlSignals
fields.description: For craps [url|pattern]_signals, please avoid accessing these fields directly... use methods from quality/navboost/craps/craps-lossy-compression.h or talk to craps-team@.

fields.name: navDemotion
fields.description: nav_demotion: converted from QualityBoost.nav_demoted.boost.

fields.name: pqData
fields.description: Encoded page-level PQ signals.

fields.name: serpDemotion
fields.description: serp demotion: applied in Qstar.

fields.name: anchorMismatchDemotion
fields.description: anchor_mismatch_demotion: converted from QualityBoost.mismatched.boost.

fields.name: ugcDiscussionEffortScore
fields.description: UGC page quality signals. (Times 1000 and floored)

fields.name: productReviewPUhqPage
fields.description: The possibility of a page being a high quality review page.

fields.name: productReviewPReviewPage
fields.description: Fields...

fields.name: topicEmbeddingsVersionedData
fields.description: Versioned TopicEmbeddings data to be populated later into superroot / used directly in scorers.

fields.name: experimentalQstarDeltaSignal
fields.description: Not propagated to shards. Populated at serving time... read by an experimental Q* component to quickly run LEs with new delta components. See go/0DayLEs.

fields.name: experimentalQstarSiteSignal
fields.description: Not propagated to shards. Populated at serving time... read by an experimental Q* component to quickly run LEs with new site components. See go/0DayLEs.

fields.name: experimentalQstarSignal
fields.description: Not propagated to shards. Populated at serving time... read by an experimental Q* component to quickly run LEs with new components. See go/0DayLEs.

fields.name: experimentalNsrTeamWsjData
fields.description: Not propagated to shards, populated at serving time by go/web-signal-joins. Only for LEs, not for launches.

fields.name: experimentalNsrTeamData
fields.description: Not propagated to shards, populated at serving time by go/web-signal-joins. Only for LEs, not for launches.

fields.name: nsrVersionedData
fields.description: Versioned NSR score... deprecated - used the equivalent field inside nsr_data_proto instead.

fields.name: nsrConfidence
fields.description: deprecated - use nsr_variance inside nsr_data_proto instead.

fields.name: lowQuality
fields.description: S2V low quality score: converted from quality_nsr.NsrData, applied in Qstar.

fields.name: pairwiseqScoringData
fields.description: Deprecated and unused field.
